verdict.rationale: The axis applies: LiveKit runs a cloud platform with LiveKit Inference, so a data-training policy or opt-out is a fair question. The pack has no evidence of a no-training commitment, an opt-out control, or a data-usage policy. Self-hosting and PrivateLink are adjacent deployment options, not a documented guarantee against training use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
